credit: Self-contained variant of CBC cannon_carriage/carriage_axle.json. Inline texture refs sidestep Flywheel PartialModel parent-alias resolution issues that caused purple/black missing texture when the parent chain 'createbigcannons:block/cannon_carriage/textures' supplied the #axis / #axis_top aliases (see Flywheel PartialModelEventHandler.onRegisterAdditional which only bakes models present in PartialModel.ALL at bake time and cannot re-resolve parent chains lazily). Textures restored to Create's own shaft axis pattern (create:block/axis + create:block/axis_top) matching CBC's original visual style so the carriage axle reads as 'mechanical shaft' per user request '耳轴使用的黄铜贴图也应该改回机械动力转轴的样式'. Face UV rects and rotation angles copied verbatim from CBC's original carriage_axle.json. The two faces with UV [0,0,0,0] are CBC's design choice to make the axle half-cubes' inner meeting faces invisible so the two halves butt together at model X=8 without z-fighting.
